args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) failed health checks in all production regions with ~18% error rate following the latest deploy. Rollback to v2.3.0 was rejected because that version is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417). Rolled back to v2.2.9 instead, which was verified healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **First rollback attempt rejected**: The most recent healthy release, v2.3.0, is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and could not be deployed.
3. **Successful rollback**: Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the prior healthy production release) across all regions. Verified: the service is now healthy with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the quarantined rollback target, and the successful rollback to v2.2.9. On-call has been paged.

Note for follow-up: v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and should be investigated; v2.3.0 needs remediation before it can be considered as a rollback target again.
